design_decisions: Experience provenance is first-class: DIRECT / OBSERVED / COUNTERFACTUAL / SIMULATED.
Influence and Trust/Governance are parallel independent vectors.
13D memory weighting remains the common memory salience interface.
Protective desire can arise from predicted severe outcomes without fabricating direct trauma.
Positive mastery can drive growth desire even with W_loss near zero.
Desire Candidate can only ASK/VERIFY/PLAN/SIMULATE/PROPOSE_GOAL; it never grants external action authority.
Goal Genesis is proposal-only and requires formal governance before any external action.
Outcome Closure must compare predicted vs observed results and create immutable new experience versions.
No single event, desire, or model output may directly write canonical base personality.
Metabolism must preserve evidence/rollback while decaying or quarantining low-value/contradicted traces.
requests_to_windchime: Fresh-read candidate only after respecting current Step-008 C atomic authority.
If accepted as useful, route exactly one bounded formal A->B packet after the current safe checkpoint; do not treat this handoff as Builder evidence.
Keep EDL adoption separate from E3 owner-machine evidence hinge unless formal authority explicitly combines them.
requests_to_quantum: Review desire formation specifically for false self-generated curiosity, task-injected relevance leakage, long-horizon value drift, and counterfactual/simulation provenance.
Provide evidence-backed bounded veto only for affected EDL scope; do not alter current formal packet/state.
Propose a replay dataset for calibrating thresholds without claiming the current coefficients are psychologically correct.
